import base64,hashlib,json,subprocess; from pathlib import Path
run="managed-20261023-verify-complete-manual-01"
prefix="docs/agent/implementation-runs/"+run
report=prefix+".json"; pending=prefix+"/handoff.json"
r=json.loads(Path(report).read_text())
assert r["inspectedCommit"]==subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--cached","--name-only"],text=True).strip()
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","HEAD","--name-only"],text=True).strip()
actual=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard"],text=True).splitlines())|{pending}
assert actual==set(r["changedPaths"]),(actual,set(r["changedPaths"]))
owned={"androidApp/src/test/kotlin/org/asyncttwiz/android/CompleteManualFixVerificationTest.kt","protocol/src/commonTest/kotlin/org/asyncttwiz/protocol/CompleteManualFixVerificationTest.kt",report}
assert all(p in owned or p.startswith(prefix+"/") for p in actual)
for check in r["checks"]:
 p=check["evidence"]
 if p==pending: continue
 e=json.loads(Path(p).read_text()); assert e["exitCode"]==check["exitCode"]
 raw=e["output"].encode() if "output" in e else base64.b64decode(e["outputBase64"])
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==e["outputSha256"],p
for name in ("diagnostic-junit.json","junit.json"):
 for entry in json.loads(Path(prefix+"/"+name).read_text()).values(): assert hashlib.sha256(base64.b64decode(entry["base64"])).hexdigest()==entry["sha256"]
for p in actual-{pending}:
 for n,line in enumerate(Path(p).read_text().splitlines(),1): assert line==line.rstrip(),(p,n)
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],check=True)
print(json.dumps({"report":report,"changedPaths":sorted(actual),"allRetainedOutputsAndXmlHashesMatch":True,"trackedCandidateAndStateUnchanged":True,"preSaveIndexEmpty":True,"whitespace":"pass","applicationTransitionsOrValidators":False},indent=2))
